definitions.explanation: A set point in time by which something must be completed or submitted.
The date after which something is no longer valid or usable, such as a product's shelf life or a document's validity.

examples.japanese: {提出|ていしゅつ}{期限|きげん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{金曜日|きんようび}→金曜日：00642_kinyoubi⟧です。
{期限|きげん}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please submit the documents by the deadline.

examples.japanese: ⟦{申|もう}し{込|こ}み→申し込み：03161_moushikomi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{期限|きげん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{過|す}ぎて→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧しまった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦しかない→〜しかない：30533_shikanai⟧。
examples.english: The application deadline has passed, so there is no choice but to wait until next year.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{牛乳|ぎゅうにゅう}→牛乳：00777_gyuunyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{期限|きげん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れている→切れる：01936_kireru⟧。
examples.english: This milk is past its expiration date.

examples.japanese: ⟦パスポート→パスポート：00341_pasupooto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{有効|ゆうこう}{期限|きげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please check the expiration date of your passport.

examples.japanese: {賞味|しょうみ}{期限|きげん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近|ちか}い→近い：00530_chikai⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{割引|わりびき}→割引：01526_waribiki⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Products nearing their best-before date are often discounted.

notes:
USAGE:
A versatile noun used in both administrative and everyday contexts. As a deadline (sense 1), it pairs with ⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}→提出：03542_teishutsu⟧ (submission), ⟦{申|もう}し{込|こ}み→申し込み：03161_moushikomi⟧ (application), and {支払|しはら}い (payment). As an expiration date (sense 2), it pairs with {賞味|しょうみ} (best-before), ⟦{消費|しょうひ}→消費：03240_shouhi⟧ (use-by), and ⟦{有効|ゆうこう}→有効：03645_yuukou⟧ (validity).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {期限|きげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧: to meet a deadline
- {期限|きげん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れる→切れる：01936_kireru⟧: to expire
- {期限|きげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{延長|えんちょう}→延長：06447_enchou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to extend a deadline
- {有効|ゆうこう}{期限|きげん}: validity period, expiration date
- {賞味|しょうみ}{期限|きげん}: best-before date
- {提出|ていしゅつ}{期限|きげん}: submission deadline

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧: deadline (more casual, used for work and projects)
- ⟦{納期|のうき}→納期：07772_nouki⟧: delivery deadline (business term)
